'''Joe Trembley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 All American Collectibles tournament]] on 18 November 2000 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]], according to Norman Horn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1473">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-19-the-short-report-from-norm-11-18-00-aacd1473/ the-short-report-from-norm-11-18-00-aac], DeckTech (Norman "Norman" Horn, 19 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-19-the-short-report-from-norm-11-18-00-aacd1473/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
